title: Global structure and holonomy of conserved resolutions in the cylindrical Dirac doublet
summary: Cylindrical Dirac modes underlie constructions in rotating QCD matter, boost-invariant Dirac-field quantization in heavy-ion physics, and high-energy twisted-particle scattering. The corresponding complete spinor frames can be regarded as alternative bases, but their equivalence does not determine the global behavior of eigenlines selected by conserved observables.
